main_text_status: verified: article Table 8 (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2022.02057.txt) prints the same coefficients and conventional SEs as the authors' code
replication_status: exact (authors' coefficients reproduced in Stata and fixest on the shipped data); spec sample deviates, see notes
adoption_var_note: g_true (calendar year; NA = never sanctioned) in t8_panel_v2_gtrue.rds: first sanction year of the IPC class; the three classes sanctioned before the sample (IPC 106, 111, 121) get 2004, the latest year consistent with the authors' Sanction(3+) coding in 2007 (exact year not shipped; any year <= 2004 gives identical bins). treat_var post_sanction is kept so run_spec drops IPC 60's 2015-2018 switch-off rows.
published_source: Authors' code re-run in Stata MP 16 (work copy ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2022.02057/stata/run_all.do; outreg2 export lines commented out because outreg2 is not installed). No article text or PDF is in the project, so the published value is the authors' code output on the shipped data. Table 8 column (1); published_coef is the Sanction(0) coefficient relative to the omitted Sanction(6-) bin. Nov 2 (meta-3): published_coef is now the equal-weight average of the Sanction(0), Sanction(1), Sanction(2) coefficients (event_structure post_summary 0..2, authors' reference Sanction(6-)), constructed from the article-verified Table 8 coefficients (delta-method SE from the authors' conventional vcov); the Sanction(0) coefficient alone is kept in published_coef_sanction0. Nov 2 summary rule (team-lead: summaries average every reported bin, endpoint bins included): published_coef is now the equal-weight average of Sanction(0), (1), (2) and (3+) (all printed in Table 8) in the authors' normalization, -0.01812305 (delta-method SE 0.0068883, iid); the previous value -0.0191482 is kept in published_coef_0_2. Pre-summary average -0.00671814.

event_structure.source: Table_8.do line 6 (reg decoupling sanction_yr2-sanction_yr10 n_pat_c n_pat_u n_cite_c n_cite_u i.year, absorb(IPC)): shipped dummies sanction_yr1 = rel <= -6 (omitted), yr2..yr6 = rel -5..-1, yr7..yr9 = 0..2, yr10 = rel >= 3 (article Table 8: Sanction(-5)..Sanction(3+), year 0 = sanction year), rel = year - g_true; every shipped dummy equals this coding (checked in prep_v2.R, incl. IPC 60 after its switch-off and the always-sanctioned classes in yr10 every year). Years 2007-2018 consecutive; in-sample cohorts 2014/2015, always-sanctioned classes dated 2004 via adoption_var g_true (rel >= 3 in 2007). Nothing uncovered. Endpoint 3+ excluded from the post summary.
event_structure.verified: fixest (IPC + year FE, iid SEs) with these bins + 4 controls on the authors' sample (all 1,343 rows, 123 classes, IPC 60 kept) reproduces the authors' 9 coefficients (Stata re-run) to 5.0e-08 and conventional SEs to 4.5e-08; published Table 8 digits within 4.8e-05. Authors' post average (0..2, ref <= -6) = -0.0191482 (SE 0.0073621). On the pipeline sample (IPC 60's 4 switch-off rows dropped, Hull fn 6; N = 1,339) the same bins give a post average of -0.0229389. Nov 2 summary rule: with the reported endpoint bins added to the summaries, the authors'-normalization post average is -0.01812305 (SE 0.0068883) and the pre average -0.00671814 (scratchpad/meta3/rule2/).
event_structure.summary_rule: Nov 2 rule: a bin is summarized iff the paper reports its coefficient, open endpoint bins included (Table 8 prints Sanction(3+)).

notes: Table 8 column (1): dynamic effects of U.S. sanctions on decoupling. Authors: reg decoupling sanction_yr2-sanction_yr10 n_pat_c n_pat_u n_cite_c n_cite_u i.year, absorb(IPC), conventional SEs. Bins: sanction_yr1 = rel <= -6 (omitted), yr2..yr6 = -5..-1, yr7..yr9 = 0..2, yr10 = 3+. run_spec uses the same bins (event_pre_min -5, event_post_max 2: endpoints rel <= -6 and rel >= 3) with rel = -1 as reference; with unit FE this is a reparameterization of the same model. run_spec post average = mean of rel 0, 1, 2 (the 3+ endpoint bin is excluded); pre average = mean of rel -5..-2. Controls (time-varying, class-year, Table_8_Data versions, which differ from the Table 7A n_pat_*: corr 0.97, mean difference -1.77, SD of difference 0.37): n_pat_c, n_pat_u, n_cite_c, n_cite_u. DEVIATIONS: (1) the three always-treated classes (IPC 106, 111, 121; sanctioned before 2007) are dropped (sample_filter always_tr == 0, 36 rows). In the authors' coding they sit in the 3+ bin in every year, so they only help estimate year effects; run_spec would date them to 2007 and place them in bins 0-2 in 2007-2009. (2) treat_var = post_sanction merged from Table 7A, so IPC 60's 2015-2018 rows (sanction exposure switched off) are dropped per Hull fn 6; the authors keep them in bins 1, 2, 3+. (3) SEs clustered by IPC instead of conventional. Cohorts after the drops: 2014 (IPC 54, 60, 124) and 2015 (IPC 107, 123); 115 never-treated classes. Only five treated classes: the leverage screen is expected to bind. NOV 2 AUDIT (event_structure): Ruling (b): the three always-sanctioned classes (IPC 106, 111, 121) are kept (sample_filter cleared, deviation (1) superseded) with adoption_var g_true = 2004 (sanctioned <= 2004 per the authors' Sanction(3+) coding in 2007; exact year not shipped; any year <= 2004 gives the same bins); they are always-treated for CSA/BJS. treat_var post_sanction still drops IPC 60's 2015-2018 switch-off rows (deviation (2) stands). event_structure keeps the authors' reference (rel <= -6) instead of rel -1. published_coef is the Sanction(0) coefficient alone; the authors' post average (0..2) is published_post_avg_authors_norm.
